name: Cancelled Status Reason 16 Code
definition: Specifies the reason for the cancellation status.

SCEX.name: Securities No Longer Eligible
SCEX.definition: Transaction has been cancelled; the security no longer exists or is no longer eligible on the market instructed. For corporate action related cancellation, CORP should be used.

CXLR.name: End Of Life
CXLR.definition: Transaction is rejected by the executing party, the rejection is final therefore the order is cancelled in the system.

BYIY.name: Cancelled Due To Buy In
BYIY.definition: Instruction has been cancelled because a buy-in has been initiated.

CTHP.name: Cancelled By Third Party
CTHP.definition: Instruction is cancelled by a Third party.

CANZ.name: Cancelled Split Partial Settlement
CANZ.definition: Original transaction has been cancelled and replaced to allow a partial or split settlement.

CANT.name: Cancelled Due To Transformation
CANT.definition: Original transaction has been cancelled and replaced due to a corporate action.

CSUB.name: Cancelled By Agent
CSUB.definition: Instruction has been cancelled by the agent due to an event deadline extension.

CANS.name: Cancelled By System
CANS.definition: Transaction is cancelled by the system.

CORP.name: Cancelled Due To Corporate Action
CORP.definition: Transaction has been cancelled due to a corporate action.
